name: Cunrie

attributes.attribute: a form of the goddess of Sovereignty
carries the alternate names Kundrie and Kundry

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cunrie is a woman of the Arthurian tales. Some texts give this name to the Loathly Lady, who stands as a form of the goddess of Sovereignty.

okr.objective: Cunrie is an Arthurian woman known to some as the Loathly Lady.
key_results: She is called the Loathly Lady in some texts.
She holds the shape of the goddess of Sovereignty.
The names Kundrie and Kundry also belong to her.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
